entities.name: LIMITED-SERVICE state
entities.description: UE state where only limited services are available, typically when camped on a cell that does not provide normal service.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to attach to the network for normal services.

entities.name: Combined attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure that combines attach with other functionalities like location registration.

entities.name: Attach for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to attach for emergency services.

entities.name: Attach for access to RLOS
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to attach for access to RLOS (Restricted Local Operator Services).

entities.name: Entering a cell which provides normal service
entities.description: Condition where the UE moves into a cell that offers normal network services.

relations.description: When in LIMITED-SERVICE state, the UE initiates attach procedures upon entering a normal service cell.
Entering a normal service cell triggers the UE to initiate an attach procedure.
Entering a normal service cell triggers the UE to initiate a combined attach procedure.
In LIMITED-SERVICE state, the UE may initiate attach for emergency bearer services.
In LIMITED-SERVICE state, the UE may initiate attach for access to RLOS.
